function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:

| 2026‑09‑28 | **《最後的戰士》** | 演員：布拉德·皮特、妮可·基德曼；導演：喬治·盧卡斯 | 140 分鐘 | 戰爭 / 劇情 |

> - 上表僅列出部分主流市場的熱門影片，實際上映時間可能因地區、影院排期或疫情等因素略有差異。  
> - 若您想了解某一部電影的詳細資訊（如劇情簡介、票房、評論等），請告訴我具體電影名稱，我可以為您提供更深入的資料。  

祝您觀影愉快！
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "最新的電影上映有哪些？" meaning "What are the latest movie releases?" They want a list of recent movies. We need to provide a list. There's no function call needed. Just answer. Probably mention some recent releases. Provide a few examples.
